# Johannes Grof

> Software developer and HTL Kaindorf student in south-east Styria, Austria. Builds native Mac and iPhone apps, websites and small developer tools.

The portfolio is available in English and German. Follow the project pages for release links, requirements and current availability. A public portfolio page does not necessarily mean its source code or beta is publicly available.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://johannesgrof.me/): selected work, background and contact. [Deutsch](https://johannesgrof.me/de/).
- [All projects](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/): apps, tools, experiments and an archive. [Deutsch](https://johannesgrof.me/de/projects/).

## Selected work

- [ÖffiGo](https://johannesgrof.me/oeffigo/): public transport in Austria for iPhone and Apple Watch; currently in a closed TestFlight beta. [Deutsch](https://johannesgrof.me/de/oeffigo/). [Product website](https://oeffigo.app/).
- [Kontobuch](https://kontobuch.johannesgrof.me/): free accounting notebook for HAK and HTL, available on macOS, Windows, Linux and the web.
- [BriskEdit](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/briskedit/): native Mac editor with a terminal and Markdown preview. [Deutsch](https://johannesgrof.me/de/projects/briskedit/).
- [MacPhone](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/macphone/): Bluetooth device testing through an emulator on a Mac. [Deutsch](https://johannesgrof.me/de/projects/macphone/).
- [poise](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/poise/): posture coaching using AirPods motion sensors, processed on-device.
- [agent-presence](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/agent-presence/): Discord Rich Presence for coding agents, available for macOS, Windows and Linux.
- [Caruso-Reborn](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/caruso-reborn/): internet radio for first-generation T+A Caruso systems; packaged Mac app in beta.

## More tools

- [PatchPilot](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/patchpilot/): terminal coding agent for local models with configurable permissions.
- [BottleLite](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/bottlelite/): native Mac interface for running Windows applications with Wine.
- [claude-swap-bar](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/claude-swap-bar/): Claude Code account switching and usage information in the Mac menu bar.
- [Tools](https://johannesgrof.me/projects/tools/): browser-based PDF and image tools.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jx-grxf): public repositories and release assets.
